note: 可接 on/with：catch up on sleep 补觉；catch up with sb 叙旧或追上某人
补上之前落下的事：catch up on emails/sleep/work
Let's catch up soon. 口语里常指好久不见聊聊近况
口语高频，比 understand 更强调「琢磨出来」：I can't figure it out.
指通过打听或调查得知某事，后常接 that/what/if 从句

zh: 解决；（事情）有好结果；健身
note: It'll work out. 会好起来的；I work out every day. 我每天健身
It turns out (that)… 结果发现…，讲故事时的转折常用语

zh: 最后落得；最终（处于某种状态）
note: 后接 doing/地点/形容词：We ended up staying home. 结果我们待在了家里
强调主动想出点子：come up with an idea/a plan/an excuse
Something came up. 临时有事了（推掉约会的常用说法）
come across a book 偶然看到；He comes across as shy. 他给人感觉很害羞
The movie comes out next week. 电影下周上映
也可指时尚或记忆重新出现：It's all coming back to me. 我全想起来了
It comes down to money. 说到底还是钱的问题
come off as rude 显得没礼貌
He'll come around. 他会想通的
get along with sb 和某人合得来
get over a breakup/cold 走出失恋、病好
get rid of old clothes/a habit 处理掉旧衣服、戒掉习惯
I'll get back to you. 我回头再答复你（工作场合常用）
I got into jazz last year. 我去年迷上了爵士乐
You can't get away with this. 你这样做跑不掉的
get through a hard time 熬过难关
to 是介词，后接名词或 doing：get used to living alone
You'll get the hang of it. 你很快就会上手的
I get it. 我懂了；Got it. 收到/明白
give up doing sth 放弃做某事；Don't give up! 别放弃
口语：Why not give it a shot? 为什么不试试呢
和 give it a shot 同义，更中性
go through a lot 经历了很多；go through the files 翻看文件
Let's go over the plan again. 我们再把计划过一遍
回应请求：Go ahead. 你说/你做吧
鼓励别人大胆尝试
What's going on? 怎么回事？/最近怎么样？
My alarm didn't go off. 我的闹钟没响
What could go wrong? 还能出什么岔子（常带反讽）
to 是介词，后接名词或 doing：I'm looking forward to seeing you.
look it up 查一下；Things are looking up. 情况在好转
I'll look into it. 我会查一下（客服、职场常用）
Look out! 小心！
英式更常用，美式常说 take care of
反义：look down on 看不起
look down on sb 瞧不起某人
I'll take care of it. 这事交给我（处理）

zh: 起飞；脱掉；（事业）迅速成功
note: Her career really took off. 她的事业一下子起飞了
take over the company 接管公司
take on a new project 接手新项目
较正式，多用于事件、活动
既可中性「利用机会」，也可贬义「占人便宜」
也可用作道别语：Take it easy! 保重/悠着点
Let's take a break. 歇会儿吧
安慰对方不用赶
That makes sense. 有道理；make sense of 弄懂
Make sure you lock the door. 一定要锁门
make up a story 编故事；kiss and make up 和好
make up for lost time 把耽误的时间补回来
We made it! 我们做到了；Can you make it tonight? 今晚能来吗
It really makes a difference. 真的不一样

zh: 有很大影响；起很大作用
def: to have a strong effect on someone or something
note: make a big difference to someone 对某人有很大影响
make a point of doing 特意做某事
Don't make fun of him. 别取笑他
put off doing sth 拖延；The smell put me off. 那味道让我倒胃口
I can't put up with this anymore. 我再也受不了了
put together a team/report 组建团队、整理报告
put on weight 长胖
put out a fire 灭火；put out a new album 发新专辑
set up a meeting/account 安排会议、开账户；也可指「陷害」
pick up English 自然学会英语；I'll pick you up. 我去接你
point out a mistake 指出错误
We ran out of time/milk. 时间不够了、牛奶喝完了
I ran into an old friend. 我碰到了一个老朋友
The car broke down. 车坏了；She broke down crying. 她崩溃大哭
break up with sb 和某人分手
Don't bring it up again. 别再提这事了
Carry on. 继续吧（英式常用）
Check this out! 快看这个！；check out of a hotel 退房

zh: 登记入住；办理登机；问候近况
note: I just wanted to check in. 我只是想问问你最近怎么样
Calm down! 冷静点！
Cheer up! 打起精神来！
非正式口语
Sorry, you got cut off. 抱歉，刚才信号断了
deal with a problem/customer 处理问题、应对客户
We'll figure it out. 我们会想到办法的
fill in a form 填表；fill in for sb 替某人代班
美式更常用
Don't freak out. 别慌；I totally freaked out. 我当时吓坏了
Grow up! 成熟点吧！
hang out with friends 和朋友出去玩
Hang on a second. 稍等一下
Hold on. 等等（打断对方或电话里常用）
Don't hold back. 别有所保留
keep up with sb 跟上某人；Keep up the good work! 继续保持
鼓励别人别停
Keep in mind that… 请记住……
Let's kick off the meeting. 会议开始吧
I won't let you down. 我不会让你失望的
let go of the past 放下过去；也可指解雇
I messed up. 我搞砸了
miss out on sth 错过某事；FOMO = fear of missing out
It's time to move on. 是时候向前看了
open up to sb 向某人敞开心扉
Hard work pays off. 努力会有回报
pay attention to sth 注意某事

def: to watch, listen to, or consider something carefully
note: to 后接名词或动名词。close 和 careful 强调格外留意。

def: to regard something as caused or produced by someone or something
note: attribute A to B 把 A 归因于 B。被动式 A is attributed to B 表示 A 被归因于 B。

def: to be regarded as the result or work of someone or something
note: The decline was attributed to rising costs. 下降被归因于成本上涨。

zh: 解释……的原因；占（一定比例）
def: to explain something or make up a proportion of a total
note: account for the decline 解释下降的原因；account for half 占一半

def: to help bring about a result or give support to something
note: contribute to growth 促进增长；contribute to a project 为项目出力

zh: 帮助解释；使……更容易理解
def: to make something easier to understand
note: shed light on the cause 帮助说明原因

def: to consider something when making a decision
note: take account of local conditions 考虑当地条件
I can't believe we pulled it off. 真不敢相信我们做成了
You can rely on me. 你可以信赖我
We can't rule it out. 我们不能排除这种可能
settle down and start a family 安家立业
He didn't show up. 他没来
Stop showing off. 别显摆了
语气粗鲁；朋友间 Shut up! 也可表示「不会吧！」
Slow down! 慢点！
sort out a problem 解决问题
Speak up! 大声点/说出你的想法
stick to the plan 按计划来
stick with it 坚持下去
To sum up… 总而言之……
也可指放空、不再关注
I'll think about it. 我考虑一下（委婉拒绝也常用）
What do you think of…? 你觉得……怎么样？
think twice before doing 做之前三思
throw away a chance 白白浪费机会
try out a new app 试用新应用
turn down an offer 拒绝邀约；turn down the music 把音乐调小
turn up the volume 调大音量
The hobby turned into a business. 爱好变成了生意
Wake up! 醒醒吧！
Watch out for cars. 小心车
I'm worn out. 我累坏了
Let's wrap up. 我们收尾吧
warm up before running 跑步前热身
back up your files 备份文件；I'll back you up. 我挺你
His video blew up overnight. 他的视频一夜爆红
burnout 职业倦怠
Drop by anytime. 随时来坐坐
drop out of college 大学辍学
stand out from the crowd 与众不同
What does AI stand for? AI 代表什么？
step up to the challenge 挺身应对挑战
用于对比两个观点，常与 on the one hand 搭配
in terms of price/quality 从价格、质量来看
用来补充或纠正前面的说法
引出更具体或相反的信息
转换话题，聊天缩写 BTW
At least you tried. 至少你努力过了

en: at the end of the day
note: 口语高频，用于下结论
反义：in the short run 短期内
缩写 TBH，用于坦白想法
在批评后补充对方的合理之处
No wonder you're tired. 难怪你累了
No way! 不会吧！/没门！
It's no big deal. 没事儿
It's a big deal. 这可是件大事
引出真正想说的重点
Here we go again. 又来了（无奈）

zh: 我们到了；结果就成了现在这样
note: 讲完经过后说 and here we are 表示「于是就有了现在」
递东西或肯定对方做对了时说
That's it for today. 今天就到这里
up to sb 由某人决定
What are you up to? 你在忙什么？
I used to live here. 我以前住这儿；注意与 be used to doing 区分
I was about to call you. 我正要给你打电话
You're supposed to be here at 9. 你本该九点到
I'm really into cooking. 我很喜欢做饭
It's over. 结束了
Trust me, it's worth it. 相信我，值得
can't help doing sth 忍不住做某事
I can't wait to see it. 我等不及想看了
I have no idea. 我完全不知道
You have a point. 你说得有道理
make a living as a writer 靠写作谋生
I didn't do it on purpose. 我不是故意的
on one's own 独立地
three days in a row 连续三天
同 suddenly，口语更生动
同 occasionally
同 again and again
Sooner or later, you'll find out. 你迟早会知道
I'm more or less done. 我差不多做完了
As long as you're happy. 只要你开心就好
Call me as soon as you arrive. 你一到就给我打电话
比 although 语气更强
Take an umbrella in case it rains. 带把伞以防下雨
instead of doing sth 而不是做某事
I'd walk rather than drive. 我宁愿走路也不开车
When it comes to cooking, he's the best. 说到做饭他最棒
同 to a certain extent
同 for example
He's a kid, after all. 毕竟他还是个孩子
Above all, be kind. 最重要的是要善良
用于总结

zh: 突然冒出来；不知从哪来
note: A car came out of nowhere. 一辆车突然冲出来
She called me out of the blue. 她突然给我打了电话
It's a piece of cake. 太简单了
用于社交开场
Let's hit the road. 我们出发吧
Let's call it a day. 今天就到这里吧
Are we on the same page? 我们想法一致吗？
I'm feeling a bit under the weather. 我有点不舒服
The bottom line is… 关键是……
It's a long shot, but… 希望不大，但……
I'm in the middle of something. 我正忙着呢
At some point, you have to decide. 到某个时候你总得做决定
In a way, you're right. 某种程度上你是对的
用于转折，同 having said that
先承认再转折
递进：…, not to mention the cost. 更别提花费了
多用于否定句后：I can't walk, let alone run.
So far, so good. 目前一切顺利
He left for good. 他永远离开了
反义：on purpose
Keep an eye on my bag. 帮我看一下包
Time is running out. 时间不多了
It looks like rain. 看样子要下雨
I feel like eating pizza. 我想吃披萨
I don't care about money. 我不在乎钱
It depends on you. 取决于你
focus on the details 专注细节
表示话题结束
递进补充
The video went viral. 视频火了
口语高频：That's pretty much it. 基本就这样了
That's all there is to it. 就这么简单/就这些
指空间位置；注意 in the front of 指「在……内部的前部」
口语中常表示「少数几个」，不一定正好两个
非正式，同 a lot of
连接并列成分，强调前者
Whether or not you agree… 不管你同不同意……
I'll be there no matter what. 无论如何我都会去
Let's get started. 我们开始吧（视频开场高频）
YouTube 教程高频：Go ahead and click… 直接点击……
Make sure to subscribe. 记得订阅
口语，列举后收尾：…and stuff like that
口语模糊收尾：Let's grab coffee or something.
语气缓和，表示不太确定
用来澄清，避免误解
At this point, it doesn't matter. 事到如今已经无所谓了
用于换种说法解释
That's the whole point. 这才是重点
常见于 at the end of the day
